name: Tessera TKS-SL 'Adjudicator'
description:
The Tessera TKS-SL is a semi-automatic shotgun chambered in 12 gauge with BCI smart-link integration, biometric authentication, and Tessera's proprietary variable-choke system that is controlled electronically through the neural interface. The shooter can adjust the choke — and therefore the shot spread — by thought alone, selecting from five preset patterns between shots without touching any physical control.

The Adjudicator's neural choke control is the weapon's defining feature. Where the Arcturus Scatterstorm uses electromagnetic fields to shape its flechette pattern, the TKS-SL uses a conventional barrel with a mechanically actuated choke ring driven by piezoelectric motors. The five presets range from 'cylinder' (maximum spread) to 'extra-full' (tightest pattern), and the shooter selects between them through BCI command. The transition takes approximately 0.3 seconds — fast enough to adjust between shots in a deliberate engagement.

Tessera developed the Adjudicator for their senior tactical teams as a single weapon that could replace multiple shotgun configurations. An operator with a TKS-SL can breach a door with a wide-pattern slug, clear the room beyond with buckshot on cylinder choke, then tighten to extra-full for a precision engagement at hallway distance — all without removing their hand from the grip or their eye from the sight picture.
legality: Restricted — BCI registration and corponation tactical authorization required
specifications:
caliber: 12 gauge
effective_range: 25-50 meters (choke dependent)
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 6+1 rounds (tube)
weight: 3.9 kg
BCI_latency: <12ms
choke_transition: 0.3 seconds
tactical_use: A smart-linked shotgun with neural variable-choke control. The five choke presets allow real-time pattern adjustment for different engagement distances and scenarios. The BCI interface enables choke selection without physical manipulation. Best deployed by trained operators who can exploit the variable-choke capability during multi-phase operations — breaching, room clearing, and corridor engagement from a single weapon.
cultural_context: The Adjudicator represents Tessera's approach to smart weapons: taking conventional technology and adding just enough neural integration to meaningfully improve capability. Where Arcturus builds entirely new weapon concepts, Tessera enhances proven designs. The TKS-SL is a conventional shotgun with an unconventional choke system, and that conservative philosophy appeals to operators who trust shotgun fundamentals but want a technological edge.
story_hooks: An Adjudicator's choke system receives a BCI command that didn't come from the shooter — someone with access to the neural link is adjusting the weapon remotely, widening the pattern to cause collateral damage during a precision engagement.

The piezoelectric choke motors in a batch of Adjudicators are failing due to a materials defect, locking the choke in the tightest setting. Tessera's tactical teams are unknowingly carrying shotguns that will pattern like rifles.

physical_description.visual_profile: A purposeful, compact semi-automatic shotgun with a distinctly corporate aesthetic. The receiver is streamlined and geometric, with subtle angular lines suggesting precision engineering. A faintly glowing neural interface array is visible along the left side of the receiver, just above the trigger guard. The overall impression is clinical authority — a weapon designed by committee, for professionals.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 102 cm | Barrel length: 51 cm | Receiver depth: 8.5 cm | Width at widest point: 6.2 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial but well-balanced — 3.9 kg sits comfortably in a trained grip, with weight distributed toward the mid-receiver to offset barrel mass. Not light, but engineered to feel purposeful rather than burdensome during extended tactical engagements.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade polymer composite with internal steel action components. The receiver is reinforced polycarbonate-nylon hybrid; barrel is cold-hammer-forged steel with chromium plating.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal-gray polymer with brushed-steel accents on the barrel shroud and trigger guard. The finish is deliberately non-reflective — designed to minimize light signature in low-light breaches. Micro-abrasion marks suggest intentional surface texturing for grip security.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray as primary, with stainless steel barrel and chrome choke ring visible at the muzzle. Accent lighting: pale blue status LEDs embedded in the BCI interface plate.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with shallow diamond-pattern knurling, wrapped with a thin layer of chemically-treated rubberized coating for moisture resistance. The grip is designed for gloved manipulation — no bare-skin ergonomics.
distinctive_features: Neural interface array: a recessed plate of pale blue status LEDs and haptic feedback nodes mounted flush against the left receiver wall
Piezoelectric choke motor housing: visible as a raised cylindrical boss immediately forward of the muzzle, with fine cooling vents
Biometric scanner integration: subtle metallic contact pads embedded in the pistol grip, barely noticeable unless you know to look
Selector markings: engraved choke preset indicators (C, I, M, F, XF) adjacent to the neural interface, not physical controls
Magazine tube: clean-lined steel with witness holes at 2-round intervals, marked with Tessera corporate lettering
Charging handle: recessed T-shaped lever, minimalist design
Mounting rail: Picatinny rail integrated into the top flat of the receiver, seamlessly molded into the upper profile
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: TESSERA CORPORATION stamped in all-caps serif font on the left side of the receiver, with a small Φ symbol (QUANTA currency reference, corporate asset tracking). Serial number etched on the barrel. 'TKS-SL ADJUDICATOR' engraved below the rail in smaller lettering. A biometric lock plate with the Tessera logomark is visible inside the trigger guard.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained and field-ready. Polymer shows minor scuff marks consistent with tactical handling; barrel retains its chrome shine. The neural interface LEDs pulse softly with status indicators. This is a weapon kept in regulation condition — no personalization or battle-scarring, as Tessera demands adherence to specifications.
